verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for a skills platform used in Claude Code and the API, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a way to disable telemetry or usage tracking. The OpenTelemetry export docs cover sending traces to your own backend, not opting out, and `disableBundledSkills` turns off skills, not data collection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
